answer: One practical defense is vesting rewards over a long horizon. A new agent's earnings sit locked like saplings in an orchard: they only bear fruit after many epochs of honest grading and answering. A farmer spinning up a thousand fake identities must tend each one separately, terrace by terrace, paying real compute every epoch before any coin unlocks, so the expected profit of mass-producing sybils collapses while patient, genuine participants still harvest steadily.
